newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold firms, physical demand strong.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold firms, physical demand strong.

text.p: The Istanbul gold exchange saw strong trade Tuesday on continued physical demand, despite a rises in prices, dealers said. Volume rose to 1,942 kg, from Monday's 1,194 kg.
Gold closed firmer at $328.95 an ounce and 1,682,000 per gram, compared to $328.00 and 1,675,400 lira on Monday following higher prices in European markets.
The Turkish lira strengthened slightly against the dollar at 159,100 lira versus Monday's close of 159,210.
Most of the day's trade -- 1,142 kg -- took place in the morning session, with 59.4 percent conducted in lira terms.
